headline: I build AI agents and ML models, and I test them on real problems.
intro: Atreyu Sutton. M.S. student at the ATLAS Institute at CU Boulder, with a B.A. in Computer Science. I build LLM systems and ML models end to end: an agent that has shipped 50 projects in 54 nights, a voice assistant on a robot, a lesson builder grounded in a textbook, and a demand forecasting model for a bakery.

bio: I am an engineering graduate student at the ATLAS Institute at CU Boulder, finishing the M.S. in May 2027. Before this I took a B.A. in Computer Science at Rollins College, and I have run Sutton Web Solutions, my own software practice, since 2023.

Most of what I build now is agentic. I give an LLM the right context, tools and a way to check its own work, then point it at something real: a nightly build with nobody watching, a car repair, a physics textbook. Alongside that I built a demand forecasting model for a bakery: gradient boosted trees on 1.1M sales records, checked with a walk-forward backtest.
I also build physical things, which is why three of these projects have a robot, a truck or a turntable attached. I am in Boulder, Colorado, and I can work anywhere in the USA.
